text:
claire: Quick brief — webinar + short launch next Thurs. Need a small visual bundle: hero banner (1200x628), slide hero (1920x1080), 3 microtiles (600x400), and a one-pager PDF. Also need an inbound lead-flow diagram (simple branching) for the marketing form. Target: show latency (ms) vs cost ($/k tokens) and highlight routing rules for hosted/dedicated/private. First comps by Tue noon. :calendar:

josh: Copy. Can you share the numbers and any preferred color tokens? Also want mobile-first variants and export specs.

claire: Data sheet: https://files.redwood/metrics/snapshot.csv. Use Latency on x, Cost on y. Add a small sparkline inset for per-token variance. Colors: Midnight Blue #0A4FFF for latency traces, Coral #FF6B61 for cost. White & dark logo variants required; 24px clearspace.

mar: Design notes: use Inter for body, Inter-SemiBold for headings. Microtiles should include a 1-line insight and a 2-word metric (e.g., "Batching win: 3x"). Run AA contrast check and provide alt text drafts. Animation? small SVG draw for sparkline only, <6s.

josh: For the lead-flow diagram, what tags do we push on submit? Example mapping?

claire: Tags: source, plan, intent. Routing: hosted -> marketing-nurture, dedicated -> sales-assign, private -> partner-ops. Include CSV sample in the ticket: ```form_field,webhook_key
utm_source,source
plan_choice,plan
selected_topic,intent``` Also include mock webhook payload (no keys).

brand-bot: Brand reminder: primary palette + accent. Headline type scale: H1 36px, H2 28px. Provide light/dark assets and ensure logo alt text included. Legal: avoid absolute claims without source.

mar: I'll mock two hero headlines (short/long) and three microtile layouts. Example CTAs: "Try Hosted API", "Request Dedicated Demo", "Download one-pager". Will tag Figma layers and export slices.

josh: I'll create the routing SVG and a CSV sample and attach to the ticket. What about enterprise lead handling — does sales get immediate email notify?

claire: Yes sales get immediate notify + CRM create. Put a small note on the diagram.

design-bot: Ticket created: DESIGN-5102 "Snapshot visual kit + lead-flow diagram"  assignee: mar, due: 1769070000.

mar: Deliverables: PNG hero (2 variants), PNG slide hero, 3 microtiles PNG, PDF one-pager template, routing-diagram SVG + CSV. Will upload Figma link and assets by Tue noon.

claire: Awesome — send comps to legal for a quick check once uploaded. Thanks all, ping me if blocked. :pray:
